review.notes:
Sailo is a seller tool. The account below is a seller, not a shopper — it owns a demo shop that is already stocked with products, past orders and a live event with issued tickets, so every screen has real content and no empty state blocks you.

WHAT TO TRY
1. Sign in with the account below. The Home tab opens on the shop's setup checklist and today's takings.
2. Orders — tap any order to see its lines, totals and buyer. Orders are historical demo data.
3. Store — tap a product to see its variants, stock and photos.
4. Insights — the shop's numbers over the last 30 days.
5. Settings — the signed-in account, notifications, sign out, and Delete account. Delete account is two taps from the Settings tab; it is destructive, so please do not confirm it on the demo account.

THERE IS NO PURCHASE ANYWHERE IN THIS APP
Sailo has paid plans, and they are sold only on the website. The app has no prices, no upgrade button and no link to a checkout page, and it never unlocks anything in exchange for money.

STRIPE CONNECT IS NOT A PURCHASE
Settings may offer to connect a Stripe account. That is a seller onboarding their own business so their buyers can pay them — it is account setup for receiving money, not the sale of anything to the person using the app. It opens Stripe's own hosted onboarding in a browser.

CAMERA
The camera is used for two things: scanning a buyer's ticket at check-in, and photographing a product. Both are explained at the prompt.

Questions: support@sailo.store.

en-US.title: Sailo
en-US.subtitle: Run your shop from your phone
en-US.promoText: Your shop, in your pocket. An order arrives as a notification, and you can answer it before you have put the phone down.
en-US.description:
Sailo is the phone half of your shop.

Open it and you are looking at what happened while you were away — the orders that came in, what is running low, and what the day was worth. Everything you do here is the same shop your buyers see on the web, so a price you change on the bus is live by the time you get off it.

ORDERS, ANSWERED FROM ANYWHERE
Every order lands with its lines, its totals and the buyer's details exactly as they were at checkout. Move it through packed, shipped and completed with a tap. Turn on notifications and an order reaches you the moment it is placed, not the next time you happen to open a laptop.

YOUR CATALOGUE, IN YOUR HAND
Products, variants, stock and photos. Take a photo of the thing you just made and it is on sale in under a minute. Options are priced and counted per combination, so a small in green can be sold out while a large in black is not.

TICKETS SCANNED AT THE DOOR
If you sell tickets or take bookings, the door is where the phone earns its place. Scan a buyer's ticket to check them in, see who has already arrived, and keep working when the venue's wifi does not.

NUMBERS THAT DO NOT FLATTER YOU
What sold, what did not, where visitors came from and what they were worth. Empty is shown as empty rather than as a flattering zero, and anything the view has clipped says so instead of quietly rounding it off.

THIRTY-FIVE LANGUAGES, BOTH DIRECTIONS
Sailo is translated into thirty-five languages, and right-to-left layouts are the real thing rather than a mirrored afterthought.

BUILT ON THE SHOP YOU ALREADY HAVE
Sailo gives every seller a storefront on the web with its own link, a catalogue, checkout, delivery options, coupons and invoices. This app is that shop, on your phone. Sign in with the account you already use.

Good for makers, market stalls, studios, bakeries, salons, tutors, event organisers, and anyone else who sells something and would rather not be tied to a desk.

Account deletion lives in Settings, and it deletes for real.

Paid Sailo plans are sold on sailo.store, not in this app.
